title: kith-store: messages.chat_id FK has no ON DELETE action
description: schema V1 — messages.chat_id REFERENCES chats(id) has no ON DELETE clause. With PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON, deleting a chats row while messages exist is rejected (default NO ACTION = RESTRICT). All other FKs in the schema explicitly declare ON DELETE CASCADE. The inconsistency means any future cleanup path or test teardown that tries to delete a chat row will silently fail at a distance. Fix: add ON DELETE CASCADE in the next schema migration.
